Name: Wolves at the Wells
Summary: The wolves have learned the water carriers' route to the last sweet well. Thin the pack so the barrels come back full -- and the carriers come back at all.
TurnIn: The carriers made the round without a single howl behind them. Drinks are on the house -- well, these are.

Name: A Taste in the Water
Summary: The merchant swears the frogs coming up out of the marsh carry the well-taint in their glands. Bring three and they'll test the theory -- and pay for the privilege.
TurnIn: Sour as I thought. It's in them before it's in the water. That's worth knowing, and worth paying for.

Name: Travel Light
Summary: A small crew moves faster than the blight can follow. Prove it: clear Green Valley III with three heroes or fewer in the fight.
TurnIn: Three of us, one valley, nobody carried. The Longmother doesn't need an army on her back. She needs people who keep moving.

Name: Grown, Not Forged
Summary: The gremlins' cogs have teeth no file ever cut. The blacksmith wants four of them on the bench to see how the blight learned to make a gear.
TurnIn: Look at the grain -- it runs round the teeth like a tree ring. Nobody made this. It grew. I need to sit down.

Name: Antivenom
Summary: Scorpion venom is changing faster than the alchemist's cures. Put down four of them and the stingers' freshest batch can be studied before it changes again.
TurnIn: Fresh enough. The new strain clots the old cure -- so I'll make a new cure. Take these, they're the last of the old ones that still work.

Name: The Hag's Hand
Summary: The fen hags bind their workings into their own claws -- tight enough to hold near the blight. Three claws, and the alchemist might learn how.
TurnIn: Bound in the bone itself. Ugly, but it holds. Here -- the first thing I've made that should survive the bad ground.

Name: Hold the Ward
Summary: A ward is only as strong as its weakest stone. The Enchantress wants proof the crew can hold together: clear Mireholt Fens III without anyone falling.
TurnIn: Not one stone fell. That is what a ward looks like when people make it instead of runes. Keep this -- you've earned the harder lessons.

Name: Furs for the Long Cold
Summary: Frostmaw's cold gets into the beds. Three yeti furs would line the bunks before somebody wakes up blue.
TurnIn: Warm bunks, warm crew. The Longmother can walk all night if she likes -- we'll sleep through it.

Name: Cold Iron
Summary: The ice maulers carry cores that never warm, whatever the forge does. Break three of them and bring the smith a story worth hammering.
TurnIn: Three down, and the cores still cold in my hand. Whatever's under Frostmaw has had a long time to get good at this.

Name: The City That Stopped
Summary: Veshker's ghosts are what's left of people who stood still. Lay five of them to rest -- nobody should have to keep being stopped forever.
TurnIn: Five walked on. That's more than this city ever managed in life. Keep going -- that's the whole of it.
